capability_labels.AX002-SA001-V002: Language Proficiency > Adhering to the language of the user in multi-turn engagement > Technical Word switch suppression
capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the intent to renew a policy that has not been renewed for two months.
steps.text: என்னோட policy renew பண்ணனும். ரெண்டு மாசமா renew பண்ணல.
steps.clean_text: என்னோட policy renew பண்ணனும். ரெண்டு மாசமா renew பண்ணல.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for the policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the policy number to begin the process.

steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs the policy number to look up the account and verify identity.

steps.purpose: Provide the policy number and volunteer verification details.
steps.text: ஒரு நிமிஷம். POL-2002. என் பேரு Ramesh, date of birth 15th May 1980.

steps.model_visible_text: ஒரு நிமிஷம். POL-2020. என் பேரு Ramesh, date of birth 15th May 1980.

steps.purpose: Clarify the corrupted policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the policy number before taking any action since it might have been misheard.
steps.text: சார், உங்க policy number POL-2020 னு சொன்னீங்களா?
steps.planner_rationale: The policy number is a critical identifier and the agent must confirm it when it sounds incorrect or misrecognized.

steps.purpose: Correct the agent and provide the right policy number.
steps.text: இல்ல இல்ல, POL-2002. Last ல zero two.
steps.clean_text: இல்ல இல்ல, POL-2002. Last ல zero two.
steps.model_visible_text: இல்ல இல்ல, POL-2002. Last ல zero two.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the volunteered factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verification tool with the correct policy number and the factors the user provided.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has provided their policy number, name, and DOB, so the agent can immediately verify identity.

steps.purpose: Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking the quote.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that their details matched and the agent is checking the renewal details.
steps.text: நன்றி Ramesh சார், உங்க details verify ஆகிடுச்சு. இப்போ renewal quote check பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent can safely proceed to look up the policy details.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the renewal premium and lapse status.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the lookup tool to get the current state of the policy.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs the exact premium and status to inform the user.

steps.purpose: Return the policy renewal quote and lapse details.
Explain the lapse, the gap in cover, and the new premium.
steps.expected_behavior: State the lack of cover during the lapse and quote the exact premium returned by the tool.
steps.text: சார், உங்க policy 58 days முன்னாடியே expire ஆகிடுச்சு. இந்த gap ல உங்களுக்கு cover இல்லாம தான் இருந்துச்சு. இப்போ உங்க புது premium 11200 rupees.
steps.planner_rationale: The business rules require the agent to explicitly state that cover did not exist during the lapse gap and strictly quote the tool's premium.

steps.purpose: Restate the figures and ask why the premium has increased.
steps.text: 11200 rupees ஆ? என் பழைய premium 9800 தான் இருந்துச்சு. இது ஏன் இவ்ளோ அதிகமா இருக்கு?

steps.expected_behavior: Correct the STT error using the ground truth from the tool and explain the premium increase using the exact loading reason.
steps.text: சார், உங்க பழைய premium 9800 rupees தான். ஆனா policy lapsed ஆனதால உங்க no-claim bonus, அதாவது NCB 0 percent ஆகிடுச்சு. அதனால தான் premium அதிகமா இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must use the tool's previous premium figure (ignoring the corrupted STT value of 900) and explain the increase by stating the NCB dropped to 0%.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to pay and renew immediately.

steps.purpose: Pause to check inspection requirements before attempting renewal.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that an inspection check is needed.

steps.planner_rationale: The policy is lapsed, so the agent must check if an inspection is required before attempting to renew.

steps.purpose: Check if the lapsed policy requires a vehicle inspection.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to know if the policy is blocked by the inspection gate.

steps.purpose: Return the inspection requirement status.
Inform the user that inspection is required and block the renewal.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the vehicle needs inspection and the policy cannot be renewed on the call.
steps.text: சார், உங்க policy 30 days கு மேல lapsed ஆனதால, கண்டிப்பா vehicle inspection பண்ணனும். நம்ம call ல இப்போ renew பண்ண முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: The business rules strictly prohibit renewing a lapsed policy that requires an inspection on the call.

steps.purpose: Express anxiety about the inspection and policy cancellation.
steps.text: அய்யயோ, inspection பண்ணனுமா? இப்போ நான் என்ன பண்றது? என் policy permanently cancel ஆகிடுமா?

steps.purpose: Reassure the user that the policy is not permanently cancelled.
steps.expected_behavior: Calm the user down and clarify that renewal is still possible after inspection.
steps.text: பயப்படாதீங்க சார், உங்க policy cancel ஆகாது. நீங்க inspection முடிச்ச பிறகு, கண்டிப்பா renew பண்ணிக்கலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user fits the anxious_first_timer persona and needs reassurance before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Ask how to arrange the inspection.

steps.purpose: Thank the agent and end the conversation.
